title: "INSPIRE_Disruptions_V2"
output: html_document
date: "2026-04-21"
---

The purpose of this notebook is to generate an updated version of the 2025 INSPIRE 
disruptions to HIV Services for AYA, evaluating the health impacts of different
changes to HIV care for AYA between the ages of 15 and 25.

This time we are using effects sizes drawn from the survey data collected by Gianna
from our in-country study site partners in Zambia, compiled at the end of 2025.


# Libraries, Constants, Helper Functions

## Helper functions
```{r}
base_theme <- list(
  theme_minimal(),
  theme_bw(),
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    text       = element_text(family = "sans"),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )
)

bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(rsample::analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}

# Error-bar metrics (now with 100% more error bars) [1]
aggregate.data.differences <- function(data, scenario.name, start_year, end_year, age_min, age_max,
                                       comparison_scenario = "baseline"){

  data.agg <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Year = floor(Year),
                  Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Year >= start_year, Year < end_year,
                  Age  >= age_min,  Age < age_max) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
      Died_from_HIV  = sum(Died_from_HIV  * pop_scaling_factor),
      On_ART         = sum(On_ART         * pop_scaling_factor / 2),
      Off_ART        = sum(Off_ART        * pop_scaling_factor / 2),
      .groups = "keep"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  data.agg.2 <- data.agg %>%
    dplyr::filter(scenario_name == comparison_scenario) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sim.ix,
      Newly.Infected.Base = Newly.Infected,
      Died_from_HIV.Base  = Died_from_HIV,
      On_ART.Base         = On_ART,
      Off_ART.Base        = Off_ART
    ) %>%
    merge(
      data.agg %>% dplyr::filter(scenario_name == scenario.name),
      by = "sim.ix"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Newly.Infected.diff = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.Base,
      Newly.Infected.pct  = (Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.Base)/Newly.Infected.Base,
      Died_from_HIV.diff  = Died_from_HIV  - Died_from_HIV.Base,
      Died_from_HIV.pct   = (Died_from_HIV  - Died_from_HIV.Base)/Died_from_HIV.Base,
      On_ART.diff         = On_ART         - On_ART.Base,
      On_ART.pct          = (On_ART         - On_ART.Base)/On_ART.Base,
      Off_ART.diff        = Off_ART        - Off_ART.Base,
      Off_ART.pct         = (Off_ART        - Off_ART.Base)/Off_ART.Base
    )

  data.agg.diffs <- data.agg.2 %>%
    dplyr::group_by(scenario_name) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      Newly.Infected        = mean(Newly.Infected),
      Newly.Infected.diff.sd= sd(Newly.Infected.diff),
      Newly.Infected.diff   = mean(Newly.Infected.diff),
      Newly.Infected.pct.sd = sd(Newly.Infected.pct),
      Newly.Infected.pct    = mean(Newly.Infected.pct),
      Died_from_HIV         = mean(Died_from_HIV),
      Died_from_HIV.diff.sd = sd(Died_from_HIV.diff),
      Died_from_HIV.diff    = mean(Died_from_HIV.diff),
      Died_from_HIV.pct.sd  = sd(Died_from_HIV.pct),
      Died_from_HIV.pct     = mean(Died_from_HIV.pct),
      On_ART                = mean(On_ART),
      On_ART.diff.sd        = sd(On_ART.diff),
      On_ART.diff           = mean(On_ART.diff),
      On_ART.pct.sd         = sd(On_ART.pct),
      On_ART.pct            = mean(On_ART.pct),
      Off_ART               = mean(Off_ART),
      Off_ART.diff.sd       = sd(Off_ART.diff),
      Off_ART.diff          = mean(Off_ART.diff),
      Off_ART.pct.sd        = sd(Off_ART.pct),
      Off_ART.pct           = mean(Off_ART.pct),
      .groups = "keep"
    )

  bt_resamples <- rsample::bootstraps(data.agg.2, times = 500)
  bt_resamples$mean.infected       <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Newly.Infected")
  bt_resamples$mean.infected.diff  <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Newly.Infected.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.infected.pct   <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Newly.Infected.pct")
  bt_resamples$mean.deaths         <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Died_from_HIV")
  bt_resamples$mean.deaths.diff    <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Died_from_HIV.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.deaths.pct     <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Died_from_HIV.pct")
  bt_resamples$mean.On_ART         <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "On_ART")
  bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.diff    <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "On_ART.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.pct     <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "On_ART.pct")
  bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART        <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Off_ART")
  bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.diff   <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Off_ART.diff")
  bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.pct    <- purrr::map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, "Off_ART.pct")

  infected_95      <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.infected,      probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  infected.diff_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.infected.diff, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  infected.pct_95  <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.infected.pct,  probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  deaths_95        <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.deaths,        probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  deaths.diff_95   <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.deaths.diff,   probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  deaths.pct_95    <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.deaths.pct,    probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  onart_95         <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.On_ART,        probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  onart.diff_95    <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.diff,   probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  onart.pct_95     <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.On_ART.pct,    probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  offart_95        <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART,       probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  offart.diff_95   <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.diff,  probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  offart.pct_95    <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.Off_ART.pct,   probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected_95LL      <- infected_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected_95UL      <- infected_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.diff_95LL <- infected.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.diff_95UL <- infected.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.pct_95LL  <- infected.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Newly.Infected.pct_95UL  <- infected.pct_95[[2]]

  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV_95LL       <- deaths_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV_95UL       <- deaths_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.diff_95LL  <- deaths.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.diff_95UL  <- deaths.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.pct_95LL   <- deaths.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Died_from_HIV.pct_95UL   <- deaths.pct_95[[2]]

  data.agg.diffs$On_ART_95LL              <- onart_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART_95UL              <- onart_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.diff_95LL         <- onart.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.diff_95UL         <- onart.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.pct_95LL          <- onart.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$On_ART.pct_95UL          <- onart.pct_95[[2]]

  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART_95LL             <- offart_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART_95UL             <- offart_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.diff_95LL        <- offart.diff_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.diff_95UL        <- offart.diff_95[[2]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.pct_95LL         <- offart.pct_95[[1]]
  data.agg.diffs$Off_ART.pct_95UL         <- offart.pct_95[[2]]

  data.agg.diffs %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "scenario_name",
      "Newly.Infected", "Newly.Infected_95LL", "Newly.Infected_95UL",
      "Newly.Infected.diff", "Newly.Infected.diff_95LL", "Newly.Infected.diff_95UL",
      "Newly.Infected.pct", "Newly.Infected.pct_95LL","Newly.Infected.pct_95UL",
      "Died_from_HIV", "Died_from_HIV_95LL", "Died_from_HIV_95UL",
      "Died_from_HIV.diff", "Died_from_HIV.diff_95LL", "Died_from_HIV.diff_95UL",
      "Died_from_HIV.pct", "Died_from_HIV.pct_95LL", "Died_from_HIV.pct_95UL",
      "On_ART", "On_ART_95LL", "On_ART_95UL",
      "On_ART.diff", "On_ART.diff_95LL", "On_ART.diff_95UL",
      "On_ART.pct", "On_ART.pct_95LL", "On_ART.pct_95UL",
      "Off_ART", "Off_ART_95LL", "Off_ART_95UL",
      "Off_ART.diff", "Off_ART.diff_95LL", "Off_ART.diff_95UL",
      "Off_ART.pct", "Off_ART.pct_95LL", "Off_ART.pct_95UL"
    )
}


# Helper: compute yearly per-sim metrics and then bootstrap means + 95% CI
compute_ts_with_ci <- function(data, age_min, age_max) {

  # Aggregate per sim, per scenario, per year
  yearly <- data %>%
    filter(Age >= age_min, Age < age_max) %>%
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART,
           Year    = floor(Year)) %>%
    group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>%
    summarize(
      Died_from_HIV  = sum(Died_from_HIV  * pop_scaling_factor),
      Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
      On_ART         = sum(On_ART         * pop_scaling_factor),
      Off_ART        = sum(Off_ART        * pop_scaling_factor),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ts_ci <- yearly %>%
    group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      df <- .x

      # rsample bootstraps() expects a data frame
      bts <- bootstraps(df, times = 500)

      # For each metric, compute 95% CI of the mean across sims
      metrics <- c("Newly.Infected", "Died_from_HIV", "On_ART", "Off_ART")

      summary_list <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {
        m <- paste0("mean.", metric)
        bts[[m]] <- map_dbl(bts$splits, bt_mean, metric)
        q <- quantile(bts[[m]], probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
        list(
          mean = mean(df[[metric]]),
          ll   = unname(q[1]),
          ul   = unname(q[2])
        )
      })
      names(summary_list) <- metrics

      tibble(
        Newly.Infected_mean = summary_list$Newly.Infected$mean,
        Newly.Infected_ll   = summary_list$Newly.Infected$ll,
        Newly.Infected_ul   = summary_list$Newly.Infected$ul,
        Died_from_HIV_mean  = summary_list$Died_from_HIV$mean,
        Died_from_HIV_ll    = summary_list$Died_from_HIV$ll,
        Died_from_HIV_ul    = summary_list$Died_from_HIV$ul,
        On_ART_mean         = summary_list$On_ART$mean,
        On_ART_ll           = summary_list$On_ART$ll,
        On_ART_ul           = summary_list$On_ART$ul,
        Off_ART_mean        = summary_list$Off_ART$mean,
        Off_ART_ll          = summary_list$Off_ART$ll,
        Off_ART_ul          = summary_list$Off_ART$ul
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  ts_ci
}

```


## Set up: find the directories

```{r}

# Read the scenario CSV
scenarios_df <- read_csv(scenario_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Scenario names as listed in the CSV
scenario_names <- unique(scenarios_df$Scenario)

# Discover experiment directories under the base experiment root
all_experiments <- list.dirs(path = base_experiment_root,
                             full.names = TRUE,
                             recursive  = FALSE)

# Helper: extract scenario token from an experiment directory name.
# Adjust "campaign_zmb_build-" if your naming differs.
get_experiment_scenario <- function(exp_dir) {
  b <- basename(exp_dir)
  parts <- str_split_fixed(b, "campaign_zmb_build-", 2)
  if (ncol(parts) < 2) return(NA_character_)
  right <- parts[, 2]
  scen <- str_split_fixed(right, "___", 2)[, 1]
  scen
}

# Precompute scenario token for each experiment dir
experiment_df <- tibble(
  experiment_path  = all_experiments,
  experiment_scen  = map_chr(all_experiments, get_experiment_scenario)
)

# Helper: does an experiment dir have at least one non-empty ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv?
experiment_has_valid_reports <- function(exp_dir) {
  message("Checking experiment dir: ", exp_dir)

  # List Simulation_* subdirectories (names that start with "Simulation_")
  sim_dirs <- dir_ls(exp_dir,
                     type = "directory",
                     glob = "*Simulation_*")

  if (length(sim_dirs) == 0) {
    warning("No Simulation_* subdirectories found under: ", exp_dir)
    return(FALSE)
  }

  # Build candidate report paths: Simulation_*/output/ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv
  report_paths <- file.path(sim_dirs, "output", "ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv")

  # Keep those that exist
  report_paths <- report_paths[file_exists(report_paths)]
  if (length(report_paths) == 0) {
    warning("No ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv found under any Simulation_* for: ", exp_dir)
    return(FALSE)
  }

  # Check file sizes
  sizes <- as.numeric(file_size(report_paths))
  df_check <- tibble(path = report_paths, size = sizes)
  print(df_check)

  if (any(sizes > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    #message("Found at least one non-empty report in: ", exp_dir)
    return(TRUE)
  } else {
    warning("All ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv files are size 0 for: ", exp_dir)
    return(FALSE)
  }
}

# Helper: given a scenario name, find the first experiment directory whose
# parsed scenario token exactly matches and has valid reports.
find_valid_experiment_dir <- function(scn) {
  message("Looking for experiment dir for scenario: ", scn)

  candidate_dirs <- experiment_df %>%
    filter(experiment_scen == scn) %>%
    pull(experiment_path)

  if (length(candidate_dirs) == 0) {
    warning("No experiment directories found matching scenario exactly: ", scn)
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  for (d in candidate_dirs) {
    if (experiment_has_valid_reports(d)) {
      message("Using ", d, " for scenario ", scn)
      return(d)
    }
  }

  warning("No valid populated ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv found for scenario: ", scn)
  NA_character_
}

# Build scenario-to-experiment-path map with validation and exact matching
scenario_dirs <- vapply(
  scenario_names,
  find_valid_experiment_dir,
  FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)

scenario_map <- tibble(
  scenario_name   = scenario_names,
  experiment_path = scenario_dirs
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(experiment_path))

scenario_map
```

# Run analysis

Need to compute/load baseline first
```{r}

baseline_experiment.path <-scenario_map[scenario_map$scenario_name == "inspire_disruptions_baseline",]$experiment_path
#"/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/INSPIRE/Baseline-campaign_zmb_build-inspire_disruptions_baseline___2025_06_21_10_03_45_836283/"


baseline.results <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path   = baseline_experiment.path,
  scenario_name     = "inspire_disruptions_baseline",
  summarize_columns = c(
    "Population","Infected", "On_ART",
    "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
    "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
    "ReNewlySymptomatic","SendToTemporaryART","Back2GoodART",
    "PEPFAR_ARTDropout_Yes","PEPFAR_ARTDropout_No",
    "HCTTestingLoop1_uptake","HCTTestingLoop1_PEPFAR_Delayed",
    "Program_VMMC"
  ),
  stratify_columns  = c("Year", "Age", "Gender", "IsCircumcised", "HasIntervention.PrEP"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)

# Compute population scaling and attach to baseline
baseline.pop.scaling <- baseline.results %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR,
         Age  >= 15, Age < 65) %>%
  group_by(sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP / total.pop)

baseline.results <- baseline.results %>%
  left_join(baseline.pop.scaling, by = "sim.ix")

# Save baseline as an RDS to re-use for comparison with other scenarios
baseline_rds_path <- "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Disruptions_V2/baseline_scaled.rds"
dir.create(dirname(baseline_rds_path), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_rds(baseline.results, baseline_rds_path)
```

```{r}
#----------------------------------------------------------
# Load baseline with pop_scaling_factor already attached
#----------------------------------------------------------
baseline_rds_path <- "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Disruptions_V2/baseline_scaled.rds"
baseline.results <- read_rds(baseline_rds_path)

# Make sure the scenario_name is consistent across all analysis
baseline.results <- baseline.results %>%
  mutate(scenario_name = "baseline")

# Deprecated way to detect experiments, assumes that everything is populated.
# Instead, use the scenario_map already calculated above 

# all_experiments <- list.dirs(path = base_experiment_root,
#                              full.names = TRUE,
#                              recursive  = FALSE)
# 
# experiment_df <- tibble::tibble(
#   experiment_path = all_experiments,
#   scenario_name   = purrr::map_chr(all_experiments, get_experiment_scenario)
# ) %>%
#   filter(!is.na(scenario_name)) %>%
#   # keep only the disruptions scenarios you care about
#   filter(startsWith(scenario_name, "inspire_disruptions_"))

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Loop over all non-baseline scenarios:
#    - Read scenario data
#    - Attach pop_scaling_factor (recompute or reuse baseline scaling if desired)
#    - Bind with baseline and run aggregate.data.differences(...)
#    - Save per-scenario comparison tables
#----------------------------------------------------------

for (i in c(1)){#seq_len(nrow(scenario_map))) {
  scn  <- scenario_map$scenario_name[i]
  path <- scenario_map$experiment_path[i]

  message("Comparing scenario ", scn, " to baseline")

  scn_dat <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
    experiment_path   = path,
    scenario_name     = scn,
    summarize_columns = c(
      "Population","Infected", "On_ART",
      "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
      "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
      "ReNewlySymptomatic","SendToTemporaryART","Back2GoodART",
      "PEPFAR_ARTDropout_Yes","PEPFAR_ARTDropout_No",
      "HCTTestingLoop1_uptake","HCTTestingLoop1_PEPFAR_Delayed",
      "Program_VMMC"
    ),
    stratify_columns  = c("Year", "Age", "Gender", "IsCircumcised", "HasIntervention.PrEP"),
    min_age_inclusive = 0,
    max_age_inclusive = 99
  )

  # Compute scaling for this scenario (separate from baseline)
  scn_scaling <- scn_dat %>%
    filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR,
           Age  >= 15, Age < 65) %>%
    group_by(sim.ix) %>%
    summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP / total.pop)

  scn_dat <- scn_dat %>%
    left_join(scn_scaling, by = "sim.ix")

  # Calculate and save time series
  ts_adults <- compute_ts_with_ci(scn_dat, age_min = 15, age_max = 100)
  ts_youth  <- compute_ts_with_ci(scn_dat, age_min = 15, age_max = 25)
  
  # Scenario directory (assuming you already created scn_dir earlier in loop)
  scn_dir <- file.path(output_root, scn)
  dir.create(scn_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Save CSVs for plotting later
  write_csv(ts_adults,
            file.path(scn_dir, paste0("timeseries_adults15plus_with_ci_", scn, ".csv")))
  write_csv(ts_youth,
            file.path(scn_dir, paste0("timeseries_youth15_24_with_ci_", scn, ".csv")))
  
  # Calculate differences: Combine with baseline for comparison
  dat_pair <- bind_rows(baseline.results, scn_dat)
  
  # Compute 2025–2035 metrics for 15–25 (youth) and 15–100 (adults+)
  youth_compare   <- aggregate.data.differences(dat_pair, scenario.name = scn,
                                                start_year = 2025, end_year = 2035,
                                                age_min = 15, age_max = 25)
  adults_compare  <- aggregate.data.differences(dat_pair, scenario.name = scn,
                                                start_year = 2025, end_year = 2035,
                                                age_min = 15, age_max = 100)

  write_csv(youth_compare,
            file.path(scn_dir, paste0("compare_youth_15_25_vs_baseline_", scn, ".csv")))
  write_csv(adults_compare,
            file.path(scn_dir, paste0("compare_adults_15plus_vs_baseline_", scn, ".csv")))

  # Clear memory for this scenario
  rm(scn_dat, scn_scaling, dat_pair, youth_compare, adults_compare)
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
# All immediate scenario directories
output_root_2 = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Disruptions_V2/"
scenario_dirs <- dir_ls(output_root_2, type = "directory", recurse = FALSE)

# Helper to find and bind CSVs matching a pattern
read_timeseries_files <- function(pattern) {
  files <- dir_ls(path = scenario_dirs,
                  recurse = TRUE,
                  glob = pattern,
                  type = "file")
  files <- files[file_exists(files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    warning("No files found matching pattern: ", pattern)
    return(NULL)
  }

  bind_rows(
    lapply(files, function(f) {
      df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
      # Attach scenario from filename if not already present
      if (!"scenario_name" %in% names(df)) {
        scen <- basename(f) %>%
          sub(pattern, "", .) %>%
          sub("\\.csv$", "", .)
        df$scenario_name <- scen
      }
      df
    })
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_dir <- output_root

base_theme <- list(
  theme_minimal(),
  theme_bw(),
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    text       = element_text(family = "sans"),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )
)

# Helper: generic function to plot a metric with CIs
plot_metric_ci <- function(dat, metric_prefix, ylab, scenarios, filename) {
  # metric_prefix is one of: "Newly.Infected", "Died_from_HIV", "On_ART", "Off_ART"
  dat_sub <- dat %>%
    filter(scenario_name %in% scenarios) %>%
    filter(Year >= 2015, Year <= 2035) %>%
    mutate(scenario_name = droplevels(scenario_name))

  y_mean <- paste0(metric_prefix, "_mean")
  y_ll   <- paste0(metric_prefix, "_ll")
  y_ul   <- paste0(metric_prefix, "_ul")

  p <- ggplot(dat_sub,
              aes(x = Year,
                  y = .data[[y_mean]],
                  color = scenario_name,
                  fill  = scenario_name)) +
    # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[y_ll]], ymax = .data[[y_ul]]),
    #             alpha = 0.15, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c("inspire_disruptions_all" = "#C41000", 
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage_no" = "#E69F00",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage" = "#0072B2",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_baseline" = "black")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("inspire_disruptions_all" = "#C41000", 
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage_no" = "#E69F00",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage" = "#0072B2",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_baseline" = "black")) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Year") +
    scale_y_continuous(ylab) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )

    ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, filename),
           plot = p, width = 5, height = 3, units = "in")
  
    p
}
```

```{r}
# Generic helper: find and bind CSVs matching a glob pattern under scenario_dirs
read_compare_files <- function(pattern) {
  files <- dir_ls(path = scenario_dirs,
                  recurse = FALSE,
                  glob = pattern,
                  type = "file")
  files <- files[file_exists(files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    warning("No files found matching pattern: ", pattern)
    return(NULL)
  }

  bind_rows(
    lapply(files, function(f) {
      df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
      # If scenario_name is missing, infer it from the directory name
      if (!"scenario_name" %in% names(df)) {
        scen <- basename(dirname(f))
        df$scenario_name <- scen
      }
      df
    })
  )
}
```

```{r}
compare_youth_all %>% 
  filter(scenario_name %in% c("inspire_disruptions_baseline","inspire_disruptions_all")) %>% 
  select(scenario_name, Newly.Infected, Died_from_HIV, On_ART, Off_ART,
         Newly.Infected.pct, Died_from_HIV.pct, On_ART.pct, Off_ART.pct)%>%
  # Keep only the metrics we care about
  select(
    scenario_name,
    Newly.Infected, Died_from_HIV, On_ART, Off_ART,
    Newly.Infected.pct, Died_from_HIV.pct, On_ART.pct, Off_ART.pct
  ) %>%
  # Make long: one row per scenario_name + metric
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -scenario_name,
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  # Split into absolute and pct parts
  mutate(
    type   = if_else(endsWith(metric, ".pct"), "pct", "abs"),
    metric = gsub("\\.pct$", "", metric)
  ) %>%
  # Wider on scenario_name for absolute values
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols  = c(metric, type),
    names_from  = scenario_name,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  # Keep only absolute rows and add pct-change column
  filter(type == "abs") %>%
  select(-type) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change_to_disruptions =
      (`inspire_disruptions_all` - `inspire_disruptions_baseline`) /
      `inspire_disruptions_baseline`
  ) %>% 
  select(metric, inspire_disruptions_baseline, inspire_disruptions_all, pct_change_to_disruptions) %>% 
  mutate(pct = (inspire_disruptions_all - inspire_disruptions_baseline/2)*2/inspire_disruptions_baseline )
```

```{r}
all.test.results <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path   = experiment.path,
  scenario_name     = "inspire_disruptions_all_test",
  summarize_columns = c(
    "Population","Infected", "On_ART",
    "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
    "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
    "Program_VMMC"
  ),
  stratify_columns  = c("Year", "Age", "Gender"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)

scn_dat <- rbind(all.test.results, baseline.test.results, reengage.test.results)

# Compute scaling for this scenario (separate from baseline)
scn_scaling <- scn_dat %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR,
         Age  >= 15, Age < 65) %>%
  group_by(sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP / total.pop)

scn_dat <- scn_dat %>%
  left_join(scn_scaling, by = "sim.ix")

```


```{r}
ART.coverage.aggregated.data.AYA %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2015, Year <= 2035) %>%

        y = ARTCov,
        color = scenario_name),
        linewidth = 3, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("inspire_disruptions_all_test" = "#C41000", 
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage" = "#E69F00",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_reengage_test" = "#0072B2",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_baseline_test" = "black")) +

      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
```

## Aggregate

```{r}
ART.coverage.aggregated.data.adults <- scn_dat %>% 
  filter(Age >= 15) %>% 
  #mutate(Year = ceiling(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year) %>% 
  summarize(
    Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2),
    Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor/2),
    On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2), .groups = 'drop_last'
      ) %>% 
  mutate(
    KnowStatus = Diagnosed/Infected,
    ARTCovDiagnosed = On_ART/Diagnosed,
    ARTCov = On_ART/Infected
  ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(
    Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
    Infected = mean(Infected),
    Diagnosed = mean(Diagnosed), 
    On_ART = mean(On_ART), 
    KnowStatus = mean(KnowStatus),
    ARTCovDiagnosed = mean(ARTCovDiagnosed),
    ARTCov = mean(ARTCov), .groups = 'drop_last')

ART.coverage.aggregated.data.AYA <- scn_dat %>% 
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 25) %>% 
  #mutate(Year = ceiling(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year) %>% 
    summarize(
    Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2),
    Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor/2),
    On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2), .groups = 'drop_last'
      ) %>% 
  mutate(
    KnowStatus = Diagnosed/Infected,
    ARTCovDiagnosed = On_ART/Diagnosed,
    ARTCov = On_ART/Infected
  ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(
    Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
    Infected = mean(Infected),
    Diagnosed = mean(Diagnosed), 
    On_ART = mean(On_ART), 
    KnowStatus = mean(KnowStatus),
    ARTCovDiagnosed = mean(ARTCovDiagnosed),
    ARTCov = mean(ARTCov), .groups = 'drop_last')
```

```{r}
# What is the relative fraction of adults vs adolescents on ART? 
# What fraction of all adults have their VLS adjusted?

adh_disruption_adults = ART.coverage.aggregated.data.AYA %>% 
  filter(scenario_name == 'inspire_disruptions_all') %>% 
  select(scenario_name, Year, On_ART_AYA = On_ART) %>% 
  merge(
    ART.coverage.aggregated.data.adults %>% 
      select(scenario_name, Year, On_ART_Adults = On_ART),
     by = c("scenario_name" ,"Year")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    total = On_ART_AYA + On_ART_Adults,
    On_ART_AYA_frac = On_ART_AYA/total,
    On_ART_Adults_frac = On_ART_Adults/total
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    VLS = On_ART_AYA_frac*.97 *(1-.76) + On_ART_Adults_frac*.97
  ) %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2015, Year <= 2035) %>% 
  select(Year, VLS,scenario_name)


VLS.df = rbind(
  data.frame(
    Year = c(2015:2035),
    VLS = c(0.97),
    scenario_name = c("inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage_no")
  ),
  data.frame(
    Year = c(2015:2035),
    VLS = c(0.97),
    scenario_name = c("inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage")
  ),
  data.frame(
    Year = c(2015:2035),
    VLS = c(0.97),
    scenario_name = c("inspire_disruptions_baseline")
  ),
  data.frame(
    Year = c(2015:2035),
    VLS = c(rep(0.97,11), rep(0.97 * .99 + 0.97 * (1- .76) * .01,10)),
    scenario_name = c("inspire_disruptions_all")
  )
)
  
p <- VLS.df %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(
    mapping = aes(x = Year, y = VLS, color = scenario_name), 
    linewidth = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("inspire_disruptions_all" = "#C41000", 
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage_no" = "#E69F00",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_artdrop_reengage" = "#0072B2",
                                  "inspire_disruptions_baseline" = "black")) + 
    #scale_x_continuous("Year") +
    scale_y_continuous("", limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) + 
    base_theme +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()
      )

p

ggsave(filename = file_name,
       plot = p, width = 4, height = 3, units = "in")
```
